en: Do you mind if I sit here? (to a friend)
why: After te importa si, the plain present.

en: Would you mind if I opened the door? (to a stranger, very gentle)
why: Le importaría que takes the -ra verb.

en: Do you mind if I use your phone? (to a friend)
why: Te importa si takes the plain present.

en: Would you mind if I asked you something personal?
es: ¿Te importaría que te preguntara algo personal?
why: Te importaría que takes the -ra verb.

en: Do you mind if I turn off the light? (to a friend, casual)
why: Apago is plain present, so te importa si.

en: Would you mind if we left early? (to your boss, very gently)
why: Saliéramos is the -ra verb, which goes with importaría que.

en: Do you all mind if I bring a friend?
es: ¿Les importa si traigo a una amiga?
why: Importa si takes the plain present.

en: Would you mind if Rosa came with us?
es: ¿Te importaría que Rosa viniera con nosotros?
